_instructions: Hardware lineup. Add a product by copying the shape of an existing entry. Images go in /public/img/products/.
_note_on_lease_tier: lease_tier picks which lease rate the system builder charges: 'small' or 'large', rates in pricing.json > hardware.lease. UNVERIFIED: Matt gave the two rates but not which units fall in which tier. Mini is assumed small, everything else large — the KDS is the debatable one. Correct here, not in the component.
_note_on_bestseller: Only EPAY Table is flagged Best Seller on the live page, so only it is marked here. Add others when you have the sales data — it is a factual claim.

products.name: EPAY Mini
products.summary: Take orders and take payment anywhere on the floor.
products.body: A fast, portable handheld that keeps service moving. Prints receipts on the spot, handles tableside payment, deliveries, curbside, and events.
feature_bullets: Take the order and the payment at the table
Built-in receipt printer, no docking station needed
All-day battery with Wi-Fi and LTE
Curbside, delivery, patio, and event service
Same menu and tickets as the main register
products.meta_description: EPAY Mini handheld POS: take orders and payment anywhere on the floor, print receipts on the spot, and handle tableside, curbside and events.

products.name: EPAY Table
products.summary: Full restaurant control — floor, kitchen, and payments in one system.
products.body: Ordering, kitchen communication, table management, and payment flow through one place. Dine-in, takeout, and third-party orders all land in the same ticket queue.
feature_bullets: Full table management with drag-and-drop floor plans
Split checks, merge tables, and seat-level ordering
Course firing and menu routing
Customizable menus with modifiers, combos, and add-ons
Tabs, bar mode, and quick-serve checkout
products.meta_description: EPAY Table restaurant POS: ordering, kitchen communication, table management and payments in one system, with every order in one queue.

products.name: EPAY Retail
products.summary: Everything a store needs to run the counter and the back room.
products.body: Manage inventory, track sales, run promotions, and take every payment type. Built for high-SKU counts and fast checkout lines.
feature_bullets: High-volume SKU management with barcode lookup
Age verification and ID scanning for restricted items
Promotions, mix-and-match pricing, and combo deals
Purchase orders, receiving, and vendor cost tracking
Scale and scanner support at the counter
products.meta_description: EPAY Retail POS: manage inventory, track sales, run promotions and take every payment type. Built for high-SKU counts and fast checkout.

products.name: Kitchen Display
products.summary: Replace paper tickets with a screen the line can actually read.
products.body: Orders route straight from the register to the right station. Timers, bump bars, and course firing keep tickets moving in the right order.
feature_bullets: Easy-to-use interface designed for quick learning and minimal training
Real-time order display from the POS or a handheld
Color-coded order statuses — new, in progress, completed
Automatic routing by menu item: grill, fryer, prep, bar
Ticket timers so nothing sits under the pass
products.meta_description: EPAY Kitchen Display replaces paper tickets. Orders route to the right station, with timers, bump bars and course firing to keep tickets moving.
products._note_on_gallery: Intentionally empty. The Kitchen Display uses the standard screen shot in `image` and nothing else; the gallery section is skipped when empty.

products.name: EPAY Kiosk
products.summary: Let customers order and pay themselves, straight into the same ticket queue.
products.body: A customer-facing screen that takes the order and the payment without tying up a member of staff. Orders land in the same queue as the register and the kitchen, so nothing is keyed twice and nothing is tracked separately.
specs: Takes card payment at the kiosk
Orders join the same queue as the register
feature_bullets: Customers order and pay without waiting for a member of staff
Orders arrive in the same queue as the register and the kitchen
Takes card payment at the screen
Prints the customer's receipt at the kiosk
Runs the same catalog and pricing as the rest of the system
products._note_on_gallery: Empty on purpose — only the one product shot from epaypos.net exists. Both [slug].astro and product/[id].astro skip gallery entries whose file is not on disk, so the section does not render.
products._note_on_copy: UNVERIFIED with Matt, 2026-09-29. Price and the 'Self-order' line come from content/store.json. The specs and feature bullets describe what a self-order kiosk does generally and were NOT taken from an EPAY spec sheet. Check them before this page is promoted anywhere.
products.meta_description: EPAY Kiosk: a self-order screen that takes the order and the card payment, with every order landing in the same queue as the register.
products._note_on_lease: $99 per unit per month — Matt, 2026-09-29. Overrides the small/large tiers in pricing.json, which do not cover the kiosk. Read through lib/content.ts > leaseMonthly().

_note_on_prices: Purchase prices read off the live Wix page on 2026-09-01. kitchen-display is the 349.99 sale price (regular 399.99). Lease rates are in pricing.json > hardware.lease — $19.99 small, $59.99 large, confirmed by Matt.
_note_on_accessories: Add-ons moved to content/store.json. The system builder reads items there with in_builder true and a real price; the store layout on the products page shows all of them.
_note_on_carousel: Heading for the carousel at the top of /epay-products-1. It shows every entry in `products`, in this order — reorder here to reorder the carousel.
_note_on_stations: EPAY Stations was removed — Matt confirmed it is the same unit as EPAY Retail. Every industry that listed epay-stations now lists epay-retail instead. The 'EPAY Station Receipt Rolls' accessory keeps its name because that is the SKU on the live store.
_note_on_free_kds: kitchen-display has free_with_lease: true — the builder charges no lease for it as long as at least one chargeable system is on the lease. Leasing a KDS on its own still costs the lease rate. It is still a normal purchase price on the buy-outright path.
_note_on_feature_bullets: Table and Kitchen Display bullets are taken verbatim from the live epaypos.net product page. EPAY MINI and EPAY RETAIL bullets were written from their `specs` here, NOT copied from the live site: that page currently lists Retail's features as 'drag-and-drop floor plans, split checks, merge tables, course firing' — the Table copy pasted onto the Retail product. Fix it on Wix too.
_note_on_terminal: EPAY Terminal is NOT separate hardware — it is a software mode that runs on the EPAY Mini. It lives in software.json, not here, so it never appears as something to buy, lease or add to a build.
_note_on_image_format: epay-mini, epay-retail and epay-table were PNGs of opaque product photographs — 1.0MB between them, and PNG is the wrong container for a photo with no transparency. Re-encoded to JPEG at 1200px/q82 on 2026-09-28 for a 90% saving. The originals are in tools/removed-photos/. WebP would be smaller still but this Mac has no encoder for it.
